description:
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, putting Black Lotus from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Activate Executioner's Capsule by paying {1}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it.
destroying any nonblack creature an opponent controls.
When the creature dies, Glissa and Salvaging Station trigger.
Resolve the Glissa trigger, returning Executioner's Capsule to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Salvaging Station trigger, untapping it.
Cast Executioner's Capsule by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this combo during each of your turns.
